'Canterra Minerals Corporation (TSXV:CTM) (OTCQB: CTMCF) ("Canterra" or the "Company") is pleased to announce it has entered into a Definitive Agreement...whereby Star Diamond will acquire a 100% interest in the Buffalo Hills Diamond Project...from Canterra.'

ceo_buyer.justification: The buyer is Star Diamond Corporation. Their CEO is identified in the text: 'Ewan Mason, President and CEO of Star Diamond Corporation said: "We are excited to gain control of the 50% of Buffalo Hills Diamond Project we did not own...'.
